conditional_bridge_theorem.method: Finite-dimensional min-max/Weyl spectral perturbation plus the Riesz-contour resolvent identity. No observed constants, benchmark masses, or fitted target data enter the condition.
conditional_bridge_theorem.name: FiniteSelfAdjointGapStabilityBridge
conditional_bridge_theorem.statement: Let A0 be the verified 27-mode self-adjoint model-active stiffness operator with zero cluster separated from the complement by gamma_model > 0. Let A_sel,N be the selected full Iwasawa/Strominger operator compressed to the same B_N basis, and let eta_N = ||A_sel,N - A0||_op. If epsilon_N + eta_N < gamma_model / 2, then the selected zero-cluster Riesz contour is stable, the selected complement gap is at least gamma_model - 2(eta_N + epsilon_N), and the reduced Green operator exists on the selected complement.
